audit.why: Even framing right: Naafiri wins pre-6 all-ins, Zed spikes past her at 6 and first item, pick pattern stays his late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said Skill on all seven rows; content win[] and packet both say Naafiri 1-4/5 and Zed from 6 on.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Darkin Dagger' singular in spikes[0].text — the ability is Darkin Daggers (suspectName confirmed against kit convention). Other names (Razor Shuriken, Living Shadow, Death Mark, Shadow Slash) are correct.

audit.why: Death Mark 120/110/100s; Living Shadow 20s at rank 1, 16s max — the real trade windows.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: His shadow swap re-engages the moment you look done — keep W in pocket so the second wave of the fight is also yours.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: He swaps to Living Shadow and you are suddenly alone past your pack — let the reset go rather than chase into his combo.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed wins by reaching 6 first in tempo — Death Mark into W-E-Q one-shots you, and his shadow swap dodges the pack's answer.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Body-block Razor Shuriken with minions and bleed him on contact — energy-starved pre-6 Zed loses every extended string.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late he out-picks you in isolation — group, use packmate vision to spot the Living Shadow flank, and never split alone.

His only pre-6 answer is poke with Q and a W Living Shadow reposition, so trade when his W shadow is down and you win every time.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Eviscerate for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120s at rank one — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. - Living Shadow returns every 20s early. - Your E Eviscerate is 11s — budget it for emergencies, the R for opportunities.

edits.before: R online: the vision sweep plus bigger pack makes every roam a scheduled accident for a side lane.
edits.after: His 6 outspikes yours: Death Mark into W-E-Q one-shots a dog-less Naafiri before the pack answers.
